questions.text: Which of the following setup procedures is best suited for separating a mixture of two miscible liquids with close boiling points?
questions.explanation: Fractional distillation uses a fractionating column to separate miscible liquids whose boiling points are close (less than 25°C apart). Simple distillation is used when boiling points differ significantly.

questions.text: The mass number of an element is 27 and its atomic number is 13. How many neutrons are in the nucleus of this atom?
questions.explanation: Number of neutrons = Mass number - Atomic number = 27 - 13 = 14.
